decks.notes: This aggressive Jund deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergies with cards like Witch's Oven, Cauldron Familiar, and Mayhem Devil to control the board and chip away at the opponent's life total. The addition of Ygra, Eater of All provides a powerful finisher to seal the game. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain tempo. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and steadily drain the opponent's resources to secure victory.

This deck focuses on using low-cost spirits to quickly build a board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategies. By utilizing cards that allow for tempo plays and creature evasion, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced and aggressive strategy. The inclusion of powerful spirit synergy cards like Supreme Phantom and Spell Queller strengthen the deck's ability to control the battlefield while maintaining pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck incorporates a mix of disruptive and evasive elements to maintain an aggressive tempo throughout the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Transmogrify to transform a cheap token into a powerful creature like Atraxa or Hidetsugu Consumes All. It also includes various removal spells and disruption like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Duress to control the game until the combo can be executed. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion to provide additional value. The deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up the combo to win the game quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang, Okiba Boss in combination with Parhelion II and other support cards to generate a powerful combo that can overwhelm opponents. The deck includes a mix of creature removal, card draw, counterspells, and mana fixing to ensure the combo can be executed effectively. The inclusion of cards like Faithful Mending and Thoughtseize help with card advantage and disruption, while Bitter Triumph and Can't Stay Away provide additional ways to control the board. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and outmaneuver opponents for a decisive victory.

The main concept of this deck is to consistently generate value through copying powerful creatures and spells, while using the Companion mechanic to ensure a high card count. By utilizing various copy effects and powerful spells such as Magma Opus and Creative Outburst, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of versatility and card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Quintorius Kand and Leyline Binding provide additional utility and disruption, while the land base allows for consistent mana fixing to support the deck's strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero to deal damage quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck. With a low mana curve and a mix of removal and pump spells, this deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to maintain control over the game by using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw effects. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and slow down their threats while building card advantage through card draw. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to provide additional card advantage and control options. The mana base is designed to provide the necessary colors for spells while also having utility lands to deal with problematic threats.

The main concept of this Boros Control deck is to control the board through a combination of removal spells, card advantage, and disruptive creatures. The deck aims to slow down opponents' strategies with cards like Torch the Tower and Get Lost, while also generating card advantage with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Caretaker's Talent. The deck also includes powerful finishers like The Wandering Emperor and Sunfall to close out games once the opponent is sufficiently controlled. By utilizing a mix of removal, disruption, and card advantage, this deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory.

This deck utilizes a combination of evasive creatures and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive attacks and powerful abilities. By focusing on maximizing the graveyard and hand size manipulation, this deck aims to quickly empty opponents' hands while building up their own board presence. The inclusion of powerful legendary creatures like Sheoldred and Kaito provides additional threats that can help seal the game in the deck's favor. Overall, this deck aims to establish early dominance and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This control deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to consistently tutor for powerful threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By sacrificing evolving enchantments and using Leyline Binding to lock down key threats, the deck aims to control the board while generating card advantage with Yorion, Sky Nomad. With a diverse array of powerful creatures and removal spells, the deck can adapt to a variety of matchups and outvalue opponents through resource management and strategic decision-making. Ultimately, the goal is to outlast the opponent and overwhelm them with a superior late-game board state.

This deck focuses on using sacrifice synergies to gain incremental advantage and deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven, the deck aims to create a loop of sacrificing creatures for value. Additionally, cards like Ygra, Eater of All and Scavenger's Talent provide additional ways to benefit from sacrificing creatures. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through hand disruption with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, and controlling the board with powerful creatures like Sheoldred's Edict and Archfiend of the Dross. The deck also utilizes the graveyard with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber to gain advantage. It aims to outvalue the opponent and take control of the game through efficient removal and powerful creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, targeted removal spells like Fatal Push, and powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodletter of Aclazotz. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, eliminate threats, and eventually overwhelm them with creatures that are difficult to deal with. The deck also includes utility lands like Field of Ruin and Mutavault to further control the battlefield. The goal is to dominate the game through a combination of disruption and powerful creatures.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to play cheap creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Callous Sell-Sword early on, and use burn spells like Fatal Push and Monstrous Rage to clear the way for them to attack. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional utility and consistency to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure to the opponent from the get-go and finish them off before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo with Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Reckoner Bankbuster. The goal is to control the game with disruption spells like Fatal Push, Duress, and Thoughtseize while setting up the combo. Jegantha, the Wellspring acts as a companion to provide additional value. The deck also includes removal spells like Pyroclasm and Torch the Tower to handle threats on the board. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the combo strategy and ensure consistency in casting spells.
